description: Keys whose fr-FR text stays the same as the English text: names (Moonlight, codecs, Sunshine's audio backends), numbers and units, the key names printed on the remote, the keyboard and the gamepad (OK, RETURN, PLAY/PAUSE, F1, START, LB), and words that French writes the same (Compact, Standard, Options, Mono, Wi-Fi, Ethernet). Every other key needs a French translation.
